name: Ember Scout
rules: When played, look at the top card of the Fog.

name: Lantern Bearer
rules: Your other keepers get +1 while this is in play.

name: Ash Warden
rules: When this leaves play, add 1 ember to any keeper.

name: Cinder Hound
rules: Fast. Can act the round it is played.

name: Beacon Keeper
rules: At round start, remove 1 fog from the town.

name: Smoke Screen
rules: Ignore the next Fog card this round.

name: Flare Shot
rules: Deal 2 damage to a Fog creature.

name: Hearthstone Ward
rules: Prevent all damage to your keeper this round.
